result.stdout:
Rexo.Cli - repository operating system

Usage:
  Rexo.Cli <command> [args] [options]

Built-in commands:
  version              Show tool version
  list                 List all available commands
  explain <command>    Explain a command
  doctor               Check environment and configuration
  init                 Create a starter rexo config
      --yes            Non-interactive defaults
      --template       auto|dotnet|node|generic
      --schema-source  local (default) or remote
      --with-policy    Also create policy.json from a template
      --policy-template standard|dotnet (or any embedded template)
      --with-instructions Download docs/rexo.instructions.md into repo
      --instructions-path  Repo-relative destination (default: .github/instructions/rexo.instructions.md)
      --force          Overwrite existing config
  run <command>        Run a configured command
  ui                   Open the interactive UI
  help                 Show this help

Global options:
  --json               Output as JSON
  --json-file <path>   Write JSON output to file
  --verbose            Show detailed step output
